title: Tool surface far exceeds the spec's required capabilities
evidence: src/mcp.rs:33-142 defines 17 MCP tools including derbies, team_rankings, compare_seasons, team_profile, brazilian_clubs_players beyond the ~11 asked for
suggestion: None — surfaced as positive over-delivery, not a deduction

title: MCP/JSON-RPC layer is hand-written with no SDK dependency
evidence: src/mcp.rs:308 serve() implements newline-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio; Cargo.toml deps are only csv and serde_json
suggestion: None — minimal dependency footprint; protocol (initialize/tools/list/tools/call) is implemented and tested

title: Data-quality handling matches the spec's normalization asks
evidence: src/normalize.rs canonical()/fold()/parse_date() handle state suffixes, accents (São Paulo, Grêmio) and ISO+DD/MM/YYYY dates; tests/bdd.rs:184 and :120 verify both

title: BR-Football rows with an unrecognized tournament are silently dropped
evidence: src/data.rs:328 `let Ok(comp) = Competition::parse(g("tournament")) else { continue };` skips non-Brazilian competitions without any count/log
suggestion: Optionally track a skipped-row count in file_rows/dataset_info so coverage is auditable
